cd /work/ProbabilityTheoryFormalization && cat >> /tmp/Check.lean <<'EOF'

example (A B C : Ω → ℝ) (a b c vA vB vC : ℝ)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 P) (hB2 : MemLp B 2 P) (hC2 : MemLp C 2 P)
    (hAA : (∫ ω, A ω ^ 2 ∂P) = vA)
    (hBB : (∫ ω, B ω ^ 2 ∂P) = vB)
    (hCC : (∫ ω, C ω ^ 2 ∂P) = vC)
    (hAB : (∫ ω, A ω * B ω ∂P) = 0)
    (hAC : (∫ ω, A ω * C ω ∂P) = 0)
    (hBC : (∫ ω, B ω * C ω ∂P) = 0) :
    (∫ ω, (a * A ω + b * B ω + c * C ω) ^ 2 ∂P) =
      a ^ 2 * vA + b ^ 2 * vB + c ^ 2 * vC := by
  have hAAi : Integrable (fun ω => A ω ^ 2) P := by
    simpa [pow_two] using hA2.integrable_mul hA2
  have hBBi : Integrable (fun ω => B ω ^ 2) P := by
    simpa [pow_two] using hB2.integrable_mul hB2
  have hCCi : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) P := by
    simpa [pow_two] using hC2.integrable_mul hC2
  have hABi : Integrable (fun ω => A ω * B ω) P := by
    simpa using hA2.integrable_mul hB2
  have hACi : Integrable (fun ω => A ω * C ω) P := by
    simpa using hA2.integrable_mul hC2
  have hBCi : Integrable (fun ω => B ω * C ω) P := by
    simpa using hB2.integrable_mul hC2
  calc
    (∫ ω, (a * A ω + b * B ω + c * C ω) ^ 2 ∂P) =
        ∫ ω, (a^2) * (A ω)^2 + (b^2) * (B ω)^2 + (c^2) * (C ω)^2 +
          (2*a*b) * (A ω * B ω) + (2*a*c) * (A ω * C ω) +
          (2*b*c) * (B ω * C ω) ∂P := by
            apply integral_congr_ae
            filter_upwards [] with ω
            ring
    _ = a ^ 2 * vA + b ^ 2 * vB + c ^ 2 * vC := by
      rw [integral_add, integral_add, integral_add, integral_add, integral_add]
      all_goals first | exact Integrable.const_mul _ hAAi | exact Integrable.const_mul _ hBBi |
        exact Integrable.const_mul _ hCCi | exact Integrable.const_mul _ hABi |
        exact Integrable.const_mul _ hACi | exact Integrable.const_mul _ hBCi
      simp only [integral_const_mul, hAA, hBB, hCC, hAB, hAC, hBC, mul_zero, add_zero]
EOF
/opt/lean/bin/lake env lean /tmp/Check.lean
